title: France at the World Cup
description: Les Bleus — two-time winners and a 2022 final heartbreak.

questions.q: In which years did France win the World Cup?
questions.explain: France won at home in 1998 and again in Russia 2018.

questions.q: Who scored twice as France beat Brazil 3–0 in the 1998 final?
questions.explain: Zidane headed in two goals in the final.

questions.q: France beat which team 4–2 in the 2018 final?
Who scored a hat-trick for France in the 2022 final but lost?
questions.explain: Mbappé scored three but Argentina won on penalties.

questions.q: Which Frenchman scored a record 13 goals at the 1958 World Cup?
questions.explain: Just Fontaine's 13 goals in one tournament remains a record.

questions.q: France lost the 2006 final to Italy after Zidane was sent off for what?
questions.explain: Zidane headbutted Marco Materazzi in extra time.

questions.q: Who captained and starred for France's golden generation of the early 1980s?
questions.explain: Platini led France to semi-finals in 1982 and 1986.

questions.q: Didier Deschamps won the World Cup as captain in 1998 and as what in 2018?
questions.explain: He joined a select group to win it as both captain and manager.

questions.q: Who scored France's third goal in the 1998 World Cup final to seal a 3–0 win?
questions.explain: Defensive midfielder Emmanuel Petit capped France's historic 3–0 win over Brazil by finishing a counter-attack in the closing minutes.

questions.q: France crashed out of the group stage as defending champions in which two World Cups?
questions.explain: France were eliminated in the group stage in both 2002 (scoring zero goals as holders) and 2010 amid a player revolt that shocked the football world.
